front.title: Use Case and Requirements for Reporting Output Presented to a User

abstract.t: When an agent's output is presented to a user over time, as with synthesized speech, the agent has usually generated more than the user has received at the moment an exchange stops. Existing requirements cover abandoning an exchange and cancelling a task. They do not cover telling the participants in the dialog how much of the output the user actually received. This document describes one use case with two examples, a travel booking and a voice purchase, and derives five requirements that can be incorporated into the working group's use cases and requirements document.
